description: Buddhipala Sirimanne v. A.K.S. Sumanapala and Another Buddhipala Sirimanne v. A.K.S. Sumanapala and Another View More before Hon. Sisira de Abrew, J.
parties: Buddhipala Sirimanne v. A.K.S. Sumanapala and Another Buddhipala Sirimanne v. A.K.S. Sumanapala and Another View More
keywords: The Appellant appealed against the High Court order setting aside the order of the Magistrate Court decided in favour of the Appellant. Held - Based on the evidence placed before Court, High Court order is set aside, and the judgement of the Magistrate is affirmed. Appeal allowed.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Section 66 of the Primary Courts Procedure Act No 44 of 1979
